title: Eric joins Rory Sutherland on The Bottleneck — “we reward people for cutting costs without ever holding them accountable for what happens downstream”
summary: Rory Sutherland and Elfried Samba hosted Eric for a 97-minute episode of The Bottleneck, published on 15 November. The show says Eric picked out one of Sutherland's own ideas, that cost-cutting is rewarded while downstream consequences go unaccounted for, and the episode also covers Costco's $1.50 hot dog and what profit really means.
attribution_title: Hosted by Rory Sutherland and Elfried Samba · 3,800 subscribers on YouTube
blockquote: In this clip, Eric picks out one of his favourite Rory ideas: we reward people for cutting costs without ever holding them accountable for what happens downstream.
